delivery_policy: Both formats require the same native content, appearance, editability, protected-content, playback and ending review. Missing review means candidate for either format.

PowerPoint.preservation: geometry, uniform text styling, fill, line and background within the preservation contract
PowerPoint.authoring: Artifact Tool for new PPTX; native PowerPoint editing for unsupported authoring operations
PowerPoint.verified_scope: Synthetic two-slide text/table/chart preservation and reversible in-memory editing; separate cover and ending fixtures
PowerPoint.unverified_scope: General complex-object fidelity, comprehensive animation/media playback and cross-version compatibility

Keynote.preservation: geometry and uniform text size/family/color within the preservation contract
Keynote.authoring: keynote_author.py declarative native create/edit path; controlled Keynote UI for capabilities absent from the scripting dictionary
Keynote.authoring_validation: Seven synthetic multi-slide cases passed on macOS 27.0.1 / Keynote 13.1; native chart-data save/reopen and summary/closing/skipped-appendix playback reviewed separately.
Keynote.verified_scope: Synthetic four-slide creation; text and table edits; duplicate, move, delete; notes and skipped state; RGB decoding, position, bounded fit-height; native save, PDF export and independent reopen. Native chart-data edit/save/reopen and static closing playback verified.
Keynote.unverified_scope: General complex-object fidelity; image authoring and alternate chart types; layout/master inheritance, groups, equations, mixed-font edge cases, animation/media and cross-version compatibility
